headline: Paint your nails neatly
shareable_line: Less polish on the brush, cleaner lines on the nail.

scenes.say: Polish all over your cuticles every time you paint your nails? It's usually how much is on the brush, not your shaky hand.
First, wipe one side of the brush on the bottle neck. Keep just a small bead of polish on the tip.
scenes.label: Step 1

scenes.say: Set that bead in the middle of the nail, a hair away from the cuticle. Then one stroke down the center and one down each side.
scenes.label: Step 2

scenes.say: Before it dries, dip a small flat brush in remover and trace the edge. Little slips wipe right off.
scenes.label: Step 3

scenes.say: The common mistake is a fully loaded brush, then going back over polish that's already tacky. That's what floods the edges.
scenes.label: Common mistake

scenes.say: Less polish on the brush, cleaner lines on the nail. The shopping link is in my profile.
